name: Very Merrytime Pan-Roasted Chilean Sea Bass with Celeriac Purée & Parsnip Chips
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Buttery, flaky Chilean sea bass over smooth celeriac purée is virtually fiber-free and melts in the mouth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the sea bass pan-roasted in light olive oil over smooth celeriac purée (or plain white rice) and skip the fried parsnip chips.
watchOuts: Chilean sea bass is naturally high in healthy marine oils
Skip fried parsnip chips and dairy cream in the purée if sensitive
